tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i aye ring bsnyen pa'i man ngag bzhugs so//

"$ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ ma hā shū aḥdharma dhā tu= hūm̐ badzra tsitta= ka nas dag pa de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings dang*/ lhun gyis grub pa'i ye shes kun tu snang ba'i rtsal gnyis su med cing dbyer med/ dbyer med pa'i thugs rje'i 'phro 'du e las/ sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa/ mar sna rlung rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte ba dang*/ yar sna srid pa'i rtse mor zug pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ 'khor yug thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol 'khor lo padma rin po che ral gri'i gur mtshon cha rno ba'i ngar dang ldan zhing dbal rtsub pa thams cad kyis bar mtshams med par gtams shing srub med pa cis kyang mi tshugs pa ye shes kyi me dpung chen po dmar 'ur 'ur 'bar ba'i lte bar/ klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong*/ phyogs skyong ma he brdzis pa'i gnam lcags 'bar ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar/ rgyu dang rkyen med par bdag nyid phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i 'jam dpal he ru ka de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi spyan/ khro bo'i rgyal po thams cad kyi gzugs kyi sku/ dug ha la ha la ltar mthing nag dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi pa/ yan lag rags shing gsus pa 'phyang ba/ g.yas zhal dkar la bzhad pa/ g.yon zhal dmar la chags pa/ dbus zhal mthing la rngam pa/ mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs shing ljags la khrag gi rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrug pa/ sma ra ag tshoms smin ma skra thams cad kham ser/ spyan gsum gsum sdang mig tu gzir nas bskal pa 'jig pa'i me spro ba/ khro gnyer bcings pa'i shangs kyi bu ga drug nas 'thor byed kyi rlung nag po 'tshub pa/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na 'khor lo rdo rje ral gri/ g.yon pa gsum na be con gtun shing sdigs mdzub/ thod pa lnga'i cod pan bdud dang mu stegs dang srid pa gsum gyi bdag po thams cad bsgral ba'i mgo bo lnga bcu rtsa gcig dang snying spel ba'i rgyu ma'i ga sha

rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ sbrul chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ glang po che'i ko ba rlon pa stod du gsol zhing zhing chen gyis sked dkris pa/ khrag dang bcas pa'i stag lpags sham thabs su byas pa/ dpral bar thal chen gyi chom bu/ mkhur tshos dang sna la rakta'i thig le brang gi 'dzoms su zhag gi sor ris rtse gsum gyi dbyibs su bris shing*/ rdo rje'i mtshon cha ngar ma'i gshog pa brgyangs pa g.yon brkyang nas 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrug pa'i klong na bzhugs par gyur/ spyi bor de bzhin gshegs pa'i khro bo bya khyung dkar po/ rdo rje'i rwa dang mchu sder nyi zla'i mig mtshon cha mi bzad pa'i spu gshog can/ sbrul chen po bzung nas khar za ba/ dpral bar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i dbus su/ sku'i khro bo ya ma rā dza smug nag 'khor lo dang be con can/ mgrin par padma dmar po 'dab brgyad dbus su gsung gi khro bo rta mchog rol pa dmar nag 'khor lo dang rdo rje'i zhags pa can/ snying gar rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i dbus su thugs kyi khro bo phyag rdor ljang nag rdo rje dang snying 'phreng can/ lte bar rin po che cha brgyad pa'i dbus su yon tan gyi khro bo ru sbal rngam pa mi gzan dmar ser mche sder gnam lcags las grub cing khrag gi thig le dang dug gi sme ba/ yan lag drug la mchod rten gyis mtshan pa/ snying gar lha srin gyis srog 'chang zhing lto ba srid pa'i khyams khang du snang ba/ gsang gnas su rdo rje rgya gram gyi dbus su 'phrin las kyi khro bo rdo rje phur pa mthing nag dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad pa phyag drug rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga/ me dpung kha ṭwāṃ tha ma gnyis kyis phur bu bsgril ba khro bo thams cad dpal gyi chas kyis brgyan pa'o// bsrung 'khor ltar bsgom na/ spyi bor bya khyung dkar po/ snying gar sras mchog ya ma rā tsa/ de'i snying gar dregs pa phyag rdor/

de'i snying gar ru sbal rngam pa mi gzan zhes bya'o// phrag gong gnyis su khyung mo smug nag nu kha gnyis su seng ge dkar mo ral pa sprug pa/ sog gzhug gnyis su stag mo mi ro za ba/ sta zur gnyis su sbrul nag kha nas dug rlangs 'gyed pa/ seng stag sbrul las gshin gsum yin no// g.yon du sbyor yum pe tā li mthing nag snying dang thod khrag 'dzin pa dang*/ dbyings yum mu kha le dmar smug khram shing nad rkyal 'dzin pa/ g.yas su sgrol yum e ka dza ṭī sngo skya ral gri dang g.yu spyang 'dzin pa/ khro mo dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/ rtsibs stong la phyi nang gsang ba lo zla zhag dus bzhi za ma'i gshed pho mo thams cad gdug pa can gyi mtshon cha bzung zhing drag shul chen po'i sku glang po che'i go zu gyon zhing ha ha dang hi hi'i sgra sgrog cing rngam pa'i 'chams kyis rol ba/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang 'od kyis khrag 'thung rigs lnga yab yum bkug de rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi lngas bkang bas dbang bskur/ lus gang dri ma dag chu rgyun gyen du lud pas rnam snang gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga thod pa'i gzhal yas khang du bzhugs pas rgyas btab par gyur/ de nas bsnyen pa gzhung bzhin bya/ rjes lha tshogs rang la bstim/ dge ba bsngo bar bya'o// padma dkar pos sbyar ba'o/// /maṅgalaṃ/// /
